correctness.rationale: Direct Fourier multiplication identity gives an if-and-only-if solution system. Nonzero support is invariant under inversion/doubling, forcing reciprocal coefficients and doubling squares. Two disjoint orbit regimes give all and only the claimed roots of unity; independent choices and trivial character yield the product. Blockwise right multiplication gives exact diagonalizable Peirce multiplicities. All seven finite-field-group tests (complex coefficients) passed independent direct product checks; no computations substitute for proof.
